name: You.com
desc: Search and Contents APIs sold to AI products
desc_zh: 卖给 AI 产品的搜索与网页抽取 API
solves: Putting live web data into an AI answer means scraping and cleaning pages yourself. You.com sells that layer, with zero data retention.
solves_zh: 让 AI 回答里有实时网页内容，意味着自己抓取和清洗。You.com 把这层直接卖出来，零数据留存。
best_for: Shipping an agent that must cite live pages, without building the crawler.
best_for_zh: Agent 的回答必须引用实时网页，而你不想自己养爬虫。
notes: 官网可访问，但当前落地页主推「The Leading Web Search APIs for AI / The Real-Time Web Data Layer for AI」，重心已从消费端搜索转向检索 API。本档仍按面向普通用户的搜索产品记 form=web，是否改记 api 请收口时定夺。
